verdict.rationale: New Relic's own docs say you can instrument services with OpenTelemetry for 'platform-agnostic observability' and send that OTel data into the New Relic platform. That supports the instrument-once, open-standard premise. The evidence is two thin marketing-level statements, with no detail on OTLP ingest, feature parity with New Relic's own agents, or a documented backend-switch workflow. missing for 10: documented OTLP endpoint/collector setup, evidence that OTel data gets full platform parity versus New Relic's native agents, explicit backend-portability documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of switching without re-instrumenting.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability.
By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities to analyze the data and diagnose problems.
